regime_context: The detector shows a single dominant, crowded narrative (Banks) in a deliberately trend-less, mean-reverting A-share tape where the absolute-trend gate did NOT reduce drawdown historically (gate_helps=false). Only one ranked theme besides Banks is scored as trend-eligible, so the leadership structure is narratively monopolized but not confirmed by broad participation. There is no supported strong directional view here; any lean must be humble and strictly conditional.
emerging_watch: Watching Robotics & Automation (rank 2, score 0.57, but eligible=false and no ETF proxy) as a possible early challenger to Banks. The watch retires if Robotics clears the eligibility gate (trend-gate buy signal) while Banks' breadth falls below 0.6, indicating a confirmed leadership handoff.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the sole scorable trend-eligible theme with the highest durability bar (0.76), but the detector's own backtest says the trend gate did NOT hold on this market (gate_helps=false), and the theme is simultaneously flagged as crowded (z=1.91) with one-narrative dominance at high absorption. This is not a fade call — it is a size-down/avoid direction driven by the crowding caution and the gate's failure to protect A-share drawdown. Rank leadership is an attention lens, not alpha.
evidence: eligible=true and durability_bar=0.76 (highest) — the only theme the trend discipline would even consider
crowded=true, crowding_z=1.91 — guardrail says cap, do not fade
gate_helps=false — trend gate did not reduce drawdown on China A-shares history
theses.dissent: Banks may be the only durable trend in a mean-reverting tape, and crowded leadership can persist reflexively longer than expected, so underweighting the sole eligible theme forgives the only source of coherence.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS closes above its 20-day high sustained for 10 straight sessions while the CSI 300 is also positive over the same window

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Pharma/CXO is the only OTHER trend-eligible name in the entire universe (eligible=true), yet its conviction is undermined by a durability bar of only 0.54 combined with mixed hurst and crowded=true (z=1.22). With the absolute-trend gate failing on this market and the rotation breadth collapsed to 0.09, there is no reason to prefer this secondary eligible theme over the crowded leader. This is a defensive size-down/avoid, not a directional claim.
evidence: eligible=true but durability_bar=0.54, hurst_tag=mixed — fragile eligibility
breadth_of_rotation.frac=0.09 — only 2 eligible names out of 22
gate_helps=false — gate does not protect drawdown on this market
theses.dissent: Pharma/CXO may be a counter-narrative beneficiary of unscheduled macro surprises (unscheduled_share=0.78) that force a rotation out of Banks, but the detector provides no evidence of such a confirmed handoff.

falsifier.text: 159992.SZ outperforms 512800.SS by more than 8% over 15 trading days on expanding relative volume

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
